resultsProcessor.script: doc.inPropertySchema({ required: ["mustHavePreInput"], additionalProperties: true, properties: { mustHavePreInput: { type: "string" } } }).run(() => { context.sendMetric("workflow-property-schema-validation-pre-pass", 1.0); });

var pre = context.sendToStep("pre-property-schema", ""); if (!pre.isErrored()) throw new Error("expected pre-property-schema to fail without mustHavePreInput"); context.setProperty("mustHavePreInput", "ready"); var preOk = context.sendToStep("pre-property-schema", ""); if (preOk.isErrored()) throw new Error("expected pre-property-schema to succeed with mustHavePreInput"); var postFail = context.sendToStep("post-property-schema", ""); if (!postFail.isErrored()) throw new Error("expected post-property-schema to fail without mustHaveInput"); context.setProperty("mustHaveInput", "ready"); var postOk = context.sendToStep("post-property-schema", ""); if (postOk.isErrored()) throw new Error("expected post-property-schema to succeed when mustHaveInput is set"); if (String(postOk.getProperty("mustHaveOutput") || "") !== "123") throw new Error("post-property-schema did not set mustHaveOutput"); context.sendMetric("workflow-property-schema-validation-pass", 1.0);
